title: Stop Being "Authentic": 4 Ways You NEED To Be Fake At Work Today
description:
Check out my book: https://emilydurham.org/clock-in
Everyone says authenticity is the key to success, but I'm here to tell you why bringing your "full self" to work is actually career suicide. In this video, I break down the 4 strategic masks you need to wear to survive 66 office politics, protect your peace, and get promoted—without losing your soul in the process.
We’re taught that being "fake" is bad, but in the corporate world, it's a survival skill. It's time to learn the difference between being deceitful and being professional.
